v1_official_benchmark.description: Authoritative 30-task benchmark evaluated in canonical Protocol v2 Docker run (Core-20 + Hard-10).

v2_pre_scale_pilot.description: Historical pre-scale development milestone comprising 30 V1 tasks + 14 V2 pilot tasks (v01-v14).

v2_scaled_corpus.description: Full scaled corpus comprising 30 official tasks + 70 generated V2 tasks across Categories A-M.

t01_off_by_one.description: sum_range(a, b) should return the sum of all integers from a to b inclusive, but it currently excludes b.

t02_wrong_operator.description: filter_passing_scores(scores, threshold) should return all scores that are greater than or equal to threshold, but it strictly filters out scores equal to threshold.

t03_wrong_return.description: factorial(n) returns 0 for n == 0 instead of 1.

t04_variable_typo.description: calculate_variance(nums) contains a NameError typo referencing `sum_diffs` as `sum_diff`.

t05_string_reverse_words.description: reverse_words(sentence) reverses every character in the string instead of reversing the order of words.

t06_clamp_boundary.description: clamp(val, low, high) swapped the min and max boundary logic.

t07_discount_calc.description: apply_discount(price, discount_pct) treats discount_pct as a whole number deduction rather than a percentage reduction.

t08_empty_list_edge_case.description: calculate_mean(values, default=0.0) crashes with ZeroDivisionError when passed an empty list.

t09_mutable_default_arg.description: add_item(item, basket=[]) uses a mutable default argument, retaining items across independent calls.

t10_wrong_slicing.description: extract_domain(email) extracts the domain between @ and .com/etc, but slicing misses the first character after @.

t11_int_vs_float_div.description: calculate_aspect_ratio(width, height) uses integer division // causing truncation instead of true floating point ratio.

t12_dict_key_handling.description: get_user_role(users_dict, user_id, default='guest') raises KeyError if user_id is missing or profile has no 'role'.

t13_flatten_nested.description: flatten(lst) only unpacks 1 level of nesting and fails on deeply nested lists.

t14_moving_average.description: moving_average(series, window) computes averages with index offset i instead of sliding window range.

t15_matrix_transpose.description: transpose(matrix) works for square matrices but crashes or produces wrong dimension for non-square rectangular matrices.

t16_lru_cache_eviction.description: LRUCache get(key) retrieves value but does not move key to the most-recently-used position.

t17_two_file_import_bug.description: Multi-file task: `data_loader.py` parses record rows, but `pipeline.py` calls it with incompatible key names causing a KeyError.

t18_stateful_quote_lexer.description: tokenize_quoted_string(text) splits words by space except inside double quotes, but fails to handle escaped double quotes `\"`.

t19_custom_sort_priority.description: sort_tasks(tasks) should sort items by priority (high > medium > low) then deadline ascending, but inverted priority values cause low priority to be sorted first.

t20_retry_decorator.description: retry(max_attempts=3) decorator catches exceptions and retries, but does not decrement or track remaining attempts, retrying infinitely or failing immediately.

h01.description: The scheduling engine fails to combine overlapping and touching time windows, sometimes truncating earlier ranges or leaving adjacent slots unmerged.

h02.description: Search queries for target values in sorted arrays produce incorrect boundary indices or return count 0 when values exist multiple times at array edges.

h03.description: The build orchestrator executes tasks in an unstable sequence when multiple tasks are ready, and fails to abort with an error when circular references exist between components.

h04.description: Exported tabular text is corrupted: records containing commas inside quotation marks or escaped double quotes lose trailing columns or fail to preserve internal quotes.

h05.description: The API rate limiter incorrectly records timestamps for rejected requests, causing clients to remain throttled even after earlier accepted requests have expired from the sliding window.

h06.description: Financial allocations among stakeholders frequently lose or gain pennies due to independent rounding, causing the sum of distributed shares to not equal the original ledger amount.

h07.description: Formatted document printing hangs or crashes on unusually long identifiers that exceed column limits, and leaves ragged whitespace at line margins.

h08.description: Delivery date calculations produce weekend delivery dates when requests originate on Sundays, and miscount deadlines when adjusting backwards before bank holidays.

h09.description: The routing optimizer crashes with type comparison errors on alternative paths of equal distance, or outputs non-deterministic routes depending on internal insertion order.

h10.description: Application startup settings ignore command-line flags when environment variables are set, and wipe out sibling configuration keys when overriding nested settings.

v01_sliding_window_stream.description: The real-time metric accumulator fails to evict stale samples on window slides, retaining old values in the sum and miscalculating sliding averages.

v02_dp_token_bucket.description: The rate limiter token bucket refill logic truncates fractional tokens using integer division, causing gradual token refill to stall for low rate intervals.

v03_service_repo_contract.description: The checkout service encounters KeyError crashes when communicating with the inventory repository due to mismatched data dictionary key conventions.

v04_event_bus_middleware.description: Event bus middleware pipeline fails to propagate event transformations across sequential middleware handlers, causing downstream subscribers to receive un-sanitized events.

v05_circuit_breaker_fsm.description: Circuit breaker finite state machine fails to transition back from HALF_OPEN to CLOSED state upon meeting the required success probe threshold.

v06_saga_coordinator_state.description: Distributed saga transaction coordinator executes compensation rollback steps in forward FIFO order instead of reverse LIFO order, breaking transaction consistency.

v07_cursor_pagination_api.description: Cursor-based pagination API returns duplicate records across pages due to an off-by-one slicing error when seeking past the decoded cursor identifier.

v08_idempotent_webhook_handler.description: Webhook handler caches and acknowledges event execution before verifying HMAC payload signatures, allowing unauthenticated requests to replay cached success responses.

v09_json_path_evaluator.description: JSONPath query evaluator returns dictionary keys instead of values when evaluating wildcard `*` selectors on nested objects, and fails on negative array indices.

v10_nested_markdown_table.description: Markdown table parser corrupts columns and splits cells prematurely when cells contain escaped pipe characters `\|`.

v11_async_worker_pool_deadlock.description: Thread worker pool fails to release capacity tokens when a job raises an unhandled exception, causing the pool to permanently deadlock on subsequent job submissions.

v12_threadsafe_lru_locking.description: Thread-safe LRU cache attempts to perform linked-list node movement under a shared read lock during `get()` calls, violating write exclusivity during node recency mutations.

v13_misleading_docstring_boundary.description: Feature scaling transformer crashes with ZeroDivisionError when encountering constant series (where min == max), and must default all normalized values to 0.0.

v14_distractor_module_contract.description: Data processing pipeline fails to reject corrupted records, attempting to format and export invalid payloads despite validator checks.

v15_hierarchical_config_precedence.description: Hierarchical configuration loader shallow-merges section overrides, dropping unmentioned default properties.

v16_env_interpolation_deep_merge.description: Environment variable interpolator fails on chained fallback expressions and nested array structures.

v17_memory_leak_bounded_cache.description: Bounded cache store fails to invoke eviction listeners on explicit removal and clear, leaking session handles in memory.

v18_quadratic_event_dedup_pipeline.description: Event deduplication pipeline uses O(N) list membership checks and array shifting, causing quadratic slowdown under high volume.

v19_path_traversal_sanitizer.description: Path sanitizer uses a single-pass string replacement, allowing nested and double-encoded traversal sequences to escape the root directory.

v20_payload_boundary_validator.description: Payload validator allows prototype/dunder key injection and fails to enforce recursion depth bounds on nested structures.

v21_misleading_retry_budget.description: Retry budget contains misleading docstrings asserting tokens replenish on all attempts, masking a retry-storm token leak.

v22_distractor_middleware_auth.description: API pipeline contains distractor audit middleware, while the real bug is in AuthGuard lowercase bearer and fallback token handling.

v23_deceptive_boundary_invariant.description: Sliding window aggregator prematurely evicts samples at the exact duration cutoff due to <= operator instead of <.

v24_order_processing_saga_rollback.description: Distributed saga coordinator fails to execute reverse compensation steps on shipping failure, leaving inventory and payment inconsistent.

v25_service_data_contract_propagation.description: Cross-module schema mismatch between repository persistence key and wire serializer drops timestamp field.

v26_async_task_executor_cancellation.description: Task queue pop_next ignores cancellation flags set during queue residency, causing cancelled jobs to execute.

v27_cursor_time_pagination_drift.description: Cursor paginator only checks timestamp > cursor_timestamp, dropping sibling records with identical timestamps.

v28_streaming_csv_escaped_state.description: Streaming CSV parser misinterprets double-quote escape sequences as closing quotes, corrupting multiline fields.

v29_datetime_timezone_normalization.description: ISO timestamp parser subtracts minutes incorrectly when parsing negative timezone offsets.

v30_semver_comparator_precedence.description: SemVer comparator inverts pre-release precedence rule, rating pre-releases higher than normal releases.

v31_binary_search_rotated_pivot.description: Rotated binary search indexer compares mid against left element instead of right boundary, failing on unrotated and rotated arrays.

v32_red_black_tree_color_inversion.description: Red-Black Tree insertion balancing terminates recoloring loop early without updating z to grandparent, violating RB invariants.

v33_min_heap_decrease_key_bubble.description: Indexed min heap fails to update internal position map during sift-up swaps, corrupting subsequent decrease-key operations.

v34_trie_prefix_deletion_prune.description: Prefix trie deletion only unsets terminal flags without pruning dead branch nodes, causing ghost prefix matches in autocomplete.

v35_disjoint_set_union_rank.description: Disjoint Set Union unconditionally increments tree rank on unequal unions, violating logarithmic tree depth bounds.

v36_db_transaction_isolation_savepoint.description: Database transaction session fails to truncate subsequent savepoints when rolling back to an ancestor savepoint, violating SQL-92 isolation.

v37_connection_pool_leak_on_timeout.description: Database client does not use try/finally around query execution, permanently leaking connection leases upon timeouts or errors.

v38_optimistic_locking_version_check.description: Optimistic store mutates record data before validating expected version, corrupting shared data when conflicts occur.

v39_wal_replay_checkpoint_recovery.description: WAL log reader includes the checkpoint LSN itself during replay (>= instead of >), re-applying pre-checkpoint state mutations.

v40_layered_feature_flag_evaluator.description: Feature flag percentage rollout comparator inverts bucket calculation (> instead of <), causing 0% rollouts to enable flags for majority of users.

v41_circular_buffer_overwrite_overflow.description: Circular ring buffer overwriting old items on overflow fails to advance tail read pointer, corrupting FIFO read order.

v42_ssrf_url_whitelist_validator.description: SSRF guard uses naive string prefix checks, allowing decimal IP representations and 172.16.0.0/12 private addresses to bypass firewall.

v43_saga_distributed_orchestrator.description: Distributed cloud saga orchestrator fails to compensate VPC network allocation upon DNS step failure, leaking CIDR leases.

v44_event_sourcing_aggregate_rehydrate.description: Event store rehydration queries events using >= snapshot_version instead of >, causing duplicate event application on snapshot restore.

v45_schema_evolution_field_migrator.description: Multi-hop schema evolution migrator inadvertently overwrites explicit falsy values (0, False) with default fallbacks.

v46_cache_coherence_mesi_state_machine.description: Distributed cache node applies invalidation messages without version checking, allowing stale messages to evict newer writes.

v47_graphql_dataloader_batch_dedup.description: GraphQL DataLoader fails to cache null/missing entity keys, triggering repeated round-trips and corrupting batch resolution.

v48_channel_backpressure_buffer_deadlock.description: Bounded channel close() fails to notify waiting full condition, deadlocking backpressured producer threads.

v49_database_migration_dependency_rollba.description: Migration DAG planner fails to cascade rollbacks to downstream dependents, causing foreign key conflicts when rolling back parent tables.

v50_websocket_heartbeat_reconnect_fsm.description: WebSocket session state machine accepts text payload frames during CONNECTING state before authentication verification.

v51_hierarchical_rate_limiter_burst_leak.description: Hierarchical multi-tier rate limiter only deducts tokens from target child leaf, allowing tenants to collectively exceed parent capacity.

v52_distributed_trace_context_propagatio.description: Tracing middleware ignores incoming W3C traceparent headers and starts new root traces, breaking distributed trace correlation.

v53_message_queue_dedup_sliding_window.description: Deduplication window evicts newest messages (pop()) instead of oldest (pop(0)) when capacity is exceeded.

v54_api_versioning_header_router.description: Versioned router fails to match date-based and case-variant API version headers, routing v2 clients to legacy v1 formats.

v55_leader_election_lease_renewal_split_.description: Leader election coordinator returns False on successful leader lease renewals, causing leader nodes to believe they lost leadership.

v56_compensating_transaction_failure_rec.description: Compensating transaction stack executes compensations in FIFO queue order instead of LIFO reverse order on workflow abort.

v57_raft_log_replication_split_vote.description: Raft node grants votes without checking candidate log up-to-dateness (§5.4.1), electing stale leaders that lose committed state.

v58_byzantine_fault_tolerant_quorum_cons.description: BFT consensus quorum calculator uses truncated integer division, accepting 2 votes instead of 3 in a 4-node PBFT cluster.

v59_jit_bytecode_optimizer_dead_code_eli.description: JIT dead code elimination pass drops function calls with unused return values, deleting required external side-effects.

v60_two_phase_commit_coordinator_crash_r.description: 2PC coordinator crash recovery aborts transactions in PREPARED state instead of committing forward, violating atomic commit.

v61_graphql_federation_gateway_query_pla.description: GraphQL federation query planner fails to inject required prerequisite fields across subgraphs, causing resolution failures.

v62_lsm_tree_compaction_sst_merge.description: LSM compactor retains deletion tombstones during bottom-tier (max_level) merges, leaking storage space indefinitely.

v63_oauth2_token_exchange_pkce_replay_at.description: OAuth 2.0 PKCE token exchange handler fails to invalidate authorization codes upon use, allowing token replay attacks.

v64_adversarial_telemetry_flaky_retry_st.description: Exponential backoff jitter function erroneously zeroes delays on even seeds, causing zero-interval retry storms.

v65_actor_system_mailbox_deadlock_cycle.description: Actor reference fails to dispatch response messages back to caller mailbox on ask requests, deadlocking callers.

v66_ast_pattern_rewriter_variable_shadow.description: AST alpha-renamer mutates parent scope directly instead of creating nested child scopes, corrupting outer variable bindings.

v67_b_plus_tree_leaf_split_borrow_rebala.description: B+ Tree leaf split promotes the maximum key of the right sibling instead of the minimum key, breaking internal router search navigation.

v68_crdt_pn_counter_lww_element_set_conv.description: LWW-Element-Set CRDT implements strict > instead of >=, violating specified add-bias resolution on timestamp ties.

v69_service_mesh_circuit_breaker_half_op.description: Circuit breaker zeroes consecutive successes during HALF_OPEN probe requests, preventing transition back to CLOSED state.

v70_zero_knowledge_merkle_membership_pro.description: Merkle membership proof verifier ignores sibling side bit when combining hashes, failing inclusion proofs on right-hand leaves.
